fusions.name: Fathom Press
fusions.desc: Brings the weight of deep water down on the target, dealing 34 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Pounding Surf
fusions.desc: Slams the ground and sends out a wave that deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns each for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Struck Anvil
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and each kill you make while it holds restores 6 health.

fusions.name: Flatten the Last
fusions.desc: Against an enemy at low health, your damage rises by 12%.
